description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): read a hook and its delivery log (GET /api/v1/hooks/:id and GET /api/v1/hooks/:id/deliveries) as events.hook@1 and events.hook-delivery@1. The delivery log says attempt, status, response code, latency, size and payload hash; it never returns the payload, its headers, the signature or the hook's secret. Replay is a write and needs events.hook.manage.
